description: Find UK clinics that can prescribe cannabis-based medicines. Use `near` (postcode or town) for 'near me' questions: nearest first, with miles. Filter by the conditions a clinic's published policy lists, consultation type (online, in person, phone), CQC rating, first-consultation fee, accepting patients and patient type; sort by distance, year-one clinic fees or rating. Returns up to 25 clinics at a time (page on with `offset`), each with slug, page URL, town, distance, first and follow-up fees, estimated year-one clinic fees (never medicine), consultation types, CQC rating, review score and which patient types it takes. A listed condition is the clinic's referral scope, not a statement that anyone qualifies: only a specialist decides that. It does not return doctors or appointment availability. For one clinic in full, use get_listing; to weigh several, compare_providers.

acceptingPatients.description: Only clinics showing 'Accepting patients' (an active published policy).

condition.description: Only clinics whose published policy lists this condition. One of: Anxiety / Depression; PTSD; Insomnia / Sleep disorders; Chronic pain; Neuropathic pain; Multiple Sclerosis / Spasticity; Cancer symptoms; IBD (Crohn's / Ulcerative Colitis); Migraine; Arthritis / inflammatory pain; ADHD / Autism spectrum symptoms; Endometriosis / women's health symptoms. A listed condition is the clinic's referral scope, never a statement that anyone qualifies.

consultationType.description: Only clinics offering ONLINE (video), IN_PERSON or PHONE.

cqc.description: CQC rating filter; GOOD_OR_BETTER keeps Good and Outstanding.

maxFirstConsultationFee.description: Only clinics whose first consultation costs at most this, in GBP.

near.description: A UK postcode, outcode or town, e.g. "M1 1AE", "LS6" or "Bristol". Sorts nearest first and adds miles.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page (the answer says which offset comes next). Default 0.

patientType.description: NEW_PATIENT, TRANSFER or ACTIVE_PATIENT. Drops clinics whose policy does not take it, and prices year one for that route.

query.description: Clinic name, matched as text. For a place use `near`.

radiusMiles.description: Only within this many miles of `near`. Ignored without `near`.

sort.description: distance (default with `near`), az (default otherwise), za, cheapest / dearest by year-one clinic fees, rating.

name: find_clinics

acceptingPatients.description: Shows 'Accepting patients' (an active published eligibility policy)

distanceMiles.description: Miles from `near`; null when no place was given

firstYearClinicFees.description: Estimated year-one clinic fees (consultations, membership, the clinic's prescription fee) for the asked patient type with 4 follow-ups and 12 prescriptions; never includes medicine; null when no price list is published

patientTypes.description: Patient types the published policy takes; null when the clinic publishes no policy

rating.description: Published patient reviews; null when there are none

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results

title: Find medical cannabis clinics
